{
  "name": "context-band",
  "version": "0.3.1",
  "description": "One line above the prompt: context window fill, plan rate-limit windows, per-model weekly windows and other session figures, each one a toggle in /config, colored by how full they are",
  "author": {
    "name": "Jiahao Xu"
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "model": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Model name",
      "description": "The model the session runs on, as /model shows it",
      "default": false
    },
    "folder": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Working folder",
      "description": "The name of the session's working directory",
      "default": false
    },
    "branch": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Git branch",
      "description": "The branch checked out in the working directory, when it is inside a git repository",
      "default": false
    },
    "context": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Context window fill",
      "description": "How full the context window is, as a percentage",
      "default": true
    },
    "tokens": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Context tokens",
      "description": "Tokens used over the window size beside the context percentage, like 54k/200k",
      "default": false
    },
    "session": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "5-hour window",
      "description": "The plan's 5-hour rate-limit window (subscriptions only)",
      "default": true
    },
    "weekly": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "7-day window",
      "description": "The plan's 7-day rate-limit window (subscriptions only)",
      "default": true
    },
    "resets": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Reset countdowns",
      "description": "Time until each rate-limit window resets, like (2hr 15m), after its percentage",
      "default": true
    },
    "models": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Per-model windows",
      "description": "One entry per model-scoped weekly window the account has, like Fable 36%",
      "default": true
    },
    "cost": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Session cost",
      "description": "What the session has cost so far in US dollars, as /cost totals it",
      "default": false
    },
    "turns": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Turn count",
      "description": "How many prompts have been sent this session",
      "default": false
    },
    "duration": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Session duration",
      "description": "Time since the session started, refreshed every minute",
      "default": false
    },
    "clock": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Clock",
      "description": "The current time as HH:MM, refreshed every minute",
      "default": false
    },
    "color": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Color",
      "description": "The line's color: a theme key (subtle, text, claude follow the light/dark theme) or a terminal color",
      "options": [
        "subtle",
        "text",
        "claude",
        "blue",
        "cyan",
        "green",
        "magenta",
        "yellow",
        "red",
        "white",
        "gray"
      ],
      "default": "subtle"
    },
    "warnAt": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Warn at (%)",
      "description": "A figure at or above this percentage is drawn in the warn color",
      "default": 70
    },
    "warnColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Warn color",
      "description": "The color of a figure at or above the warn percentage",
      "options": [
        "warning",
        "subtle",
        "text",
        "claude",
        "blue",
        "cyan",
        "green",
        "magenta",
        "yellow",
        "red",
        "white",
        "gray"
      ],
      "default": "warning"
    },
    "highAt": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "High at (%)",
      "description": "A figure at or above this percentage is drawn in the high color",
      "default": 90
    },
    "highColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "High color",
      "description": "The color of a figure at or above the high percentage",
      "options": [
        "error",
        "subtle",
        "text",
        "claude",
        "blue",
        "cyan",
        "green",
        "magenta",
        "yellow",
        "red",
        "white",
        "gray"
      ],
      "default": "error"
    }
  }
}
